name: Northwind Health
tagline: Clinical-committee decks: evidence first, no claim without a source.

scope_questions.why: Governance wants methods; payers want cost per outcome.

scope_questions.prompt: What are you asking the committee to approve?
scope_questions.placeholder: Adopt the revised sepsis pathway across all three sites

scope_questions.prompt: Which patient population, over what period?
scope_questions.placeholder: Adults admitted via ED, Jan–Jun 2026, n=4,812
scope_questions.why: Northwind decks state the denominator before the headline.

scope_questions.prompt: Where does each number come from?
scope_questions.placeholder: EHR extract (Epic, 2026-06-30 cut) · finance ledger FY26Q2
scope_questions.why: House rule: no claim on a slide without a source on the slide.

scope_questions.prompt: What is the safety or compliance risk if this is wrong?
What does it cost, and what does it save?

narrative.bumper_rule: Each slide ends with the inference the committee is allowed to draw.

rules: Every number carries its denominator and its data cut date.
Confidence intervals shown wherever a difference is claimed.
No percentage without the absolute count beside it.
Source line on every evidence slide.

examples.label: Sepsis pathway review, FY25
examples.note: The arc the committee is used to.
